svg.title: Assembly and order checks pass independently of the event gate
svg.desc: Manufactured P1 IMEX time and space errors and conservative FD Neumann Laplacian errors. Observed first- and second-order trends validate the implemented operators but do not rescue the failed Phase-1A event gate.
